agentUpdateInstructions: Back up first (rer export, or the authenticated transfer client for a hosted copy) and exercise a restored copy. Update to v0.1.4, run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, then rer setup locally or rer deploy --environment <name> hosted with the same environment: the 19 new migrations apply in filename order. Use the exact pinned rer 0.2.91 toolchain.
